title: G2b fix round 3: tests/test_repomap.py imports the test harness first so ROOT binds to the sandbox; drop the inert ORCH_TESTS_GREEN marker (review T-0313)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain 77c35c0, 66ff50f and dd8ab79 (the G2b chain) in git log; never drop them.
Review T-0313 on T-0307: (high) tests/test_repomap.py imports orchestrator.repomap before tests/_harness, so orchestrator/__init__.py binds ROOT to the real repository when that file loads first; running tests.test_repomap before tests.test_merge makes merge.ROOT point at the real checkout instead of the sandbox. (low) merge.py gate_env sets ORCH_TESTS_GREEN but nothing reads it.
Change: tests/test_repomap.py starts with the same harness import every other test module uses (see tests/test_merge.py's first lines) before any orchestrator import; add tests/test_repomap.py::test_root_is_sandbox asserting orchestrator.ROOT is under the harness tempdir. merge.py: delete the ORCH_TESTS_GREEN marker and the IN_TESTS_GREEN constant (nothing reads them); keep the gate always running and the refresh keyword from T-0307. Run `uv run --project . python -m unittest tests.test_repomap tests.test_merge` in that order, then the full gate.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 77c35c0 below your commit
tests/test_repomap.py::test_root_is_sandbox passes and `python -m unittest tests.test_repomap tests.test_merge` passes in that order
